title: Return Reason Addition on the Made-Good Relief - Credit Builder Accounts
content:
The relief share of the made-good relief on a Credit Builder account depends on the return code of the account's most recent returned payment, as shown on its return line.

## Return codes and additions

When the return code is R02, R03 or R04 (account closed, account not found or invalid account number), the account-change addition is added; when it is R01 or R09 (insufficient or uncollected funds), the funds addition; for any other fee-bearing code nothing is added for the return reason.

| Return code | Added to the relief share |
|---|---|
| R02, R03, R04 | account-change addition: 0.1 (10 percentage points) |
| R01, R09 | funds addition: 0.05 (5 percentage points) |
| R08, R16, R20 | nothing |
